description: Lambda Studio flows: Taifoon Lambdas drawn as n8n-like DAGs of catalogue components (trigger · read · quote · route · guard · act · settle), every act behind the vault's signer guard and signing only what its lambda's acts allow, plus the registered Taifoon Lambdas they compile to (triggers, reads, acts, signed limits, guards, what the vault owns). The builder's workspace layout and commands (taifoon-sdk lambda flow check|compile|n8n). Returns: { schema, rule, workspace{}, flows[] { id, name, what, lambda, chains[], nodes[], edges[], n8n }, lambdas{ schema, guards[], lambdas[] } }. (GET /v1/lambda/flows)

api_key.description: your tfr_ key (optional for keyless reads)

name: coord_lambda_flows
